decisions.reason: Whisk-position adjustment is already an allowed high-speed splash-mitigation option. Tuning whisk length and depth does not change the splash-control target or make any current attribute obsolete.
The physical tuning of whisk length and depth does not change the approved speed range, maximum speed, or supported operating modes.
The source changes whisk positioning dimensions, not bowl depth, capacity, or refill policy.
Whisk tuning is intended to support mixing performance but does not alter the existing smoothness, froth, or consistency acceptance criteria.
Adjusting whisk length and operating depth does not replace or modify the selected stainless-steel head design, material, or size requirement.
The source concerns mechanical whisk positioning and has no effect on placard text, location, orientation, or display sides.
Whisk length and depth tuning does not change the specified simultaneous electrical loads or required power headroom.
The source does not state that tuning the whisk changes bowl-removal clearance or the required rapid bowl-swap behavior.
Operating length and depth tuning does not modify the requirement for quick, simple, preferably tool-free whisk removal.
The source has no effect on support-base graphics, lettering, font, or logo treatment.
Mechanical tuning of whisk length and depth does not change the required wiring-plan detail level or electrical layout deliverable.
The source concerns whisk positioning during mixing and does not alter the dispensing path, pour behavior, dripping, sputtering, or beverage-preservation requirements.
